intro: Shocked kaomoji (also spelled kamoji) are Japanese-style text faces frozen in surprise — wide eyes, dropped jaws, and mind-blown shock. A shocked kaomoji such as (⊙_⊙) or Σ(°△°|||) is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and chats. Browse by intensity below and click any face to copy it instantly. Whether you search "shocked kaomoji" or "kaomoji shocked," every face here is free to copy and paste.
